notes.title: Bass Defense v1.0 is now live
notes.notes:
Dear Rhythm KINGS,

we've just released v1.0 of the game, we hope you will enjoy it as much as we do.

[b]If you like the game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3027000/Bass_Defense__Rhythm_Meets_Strategy/]please leave us a review[/url] and stay tuned, because we are continuously pumping out more and more fixes and features.[/b]

We will deliver new power-ups and Fingerton mode next. It is a simple, yet ultra hard game mode, where timing is key and means everything.

If you have any issues or questions, please contact us on the [url=https://discord.gg/4a4GZrMjWn]Bass Defense Discord Server[/url] or via any platforms below.
